# Solen Design

A cool, minimal design system: plain CSS at its core, with framework entries for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Preact and vanilla DOM. Calm porcelain neutrals, a quiet steel-blue accent, light & dark built in.

464 components live in src/components/ with live demos in the docs workbench (npm run dev → /docs/).

This file is an index. Per-component full details (props, usage, source, recreation prompt) live in:
- ai/components/<id>.json — machine-readable, one component per file
- ai/search-index.json — lightweight lookups

## Tokens & theming

- src/tokens/semantic.css — the tokens to use (--sd-canvas, --sd-ink, --sd-accent, …); palette.css holds raw scales, scales.css holds type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion
- Light & dark are one system via light-dark() and color-scheme; data-theme pins a subtree; override any token as a plain CSS variable

## 网站风格

风格目录在 docs/style.html，内置视觉风格/布局模式分类切换（?cat=layout 直达布局模式），两组卡片各自带一条分类筛选条（视觉风格 15 类、布局模式 6 类，分类标记写在卡片的 data-cat 上）；详情页 docs/style-<id>.html；每套风格的设计文档（复现提示词）：

- 量化线场（quantized-line-field）— docs/styles/quantized-line-field.md

## Agents

- ai/SKILL.md — integration notes
- ai/scripts/solen.mjs — CLI: list · search · show · pull
- npm run ai:build — regenerate the JSON surface
